subject: executor: recover panic in executor.Close() (#49222)
summary: Adds `exec.Close(e)` wrapper in `pkg/executor/internal/exec` to recover panics from `Executor.Close()`, and updates executor call sites (including child Close implementations and deferred cleanup closes) to route through it; adds regression coverage for double-close scenarios and adjusts a CTE failpoint test to assert no deadlock when Close panics.
